## About the Data

The data used throughout this website comes from the [SCORE Sports Data Repository: NCAA Division I Softball Batting (2021–2022)](https://data.scorenetwork.org/softball/softball_d1_2021-2022.html), part of the [SCORE Network](https://scorenetwork.org/) collection of sports datasets curated from official [NCAA Division I Softball Statistics](https://stats.ncaa.org/). Together, the 2021 (`batting2021.csv`, 2,131 players) and 2022 (`batting2022.csv`, 2,275 players) files cover 4,406 qualifying player-seasons across 302 Division I programs, recording plate appearances, hits, extra-base hits, home runs, walks, strikeouts, stolen bases, and rate statistics (`BA`, `OBP`, `SLG`, and `OPS`).
